facts: A clean solid sampled schematic replaces irregular scan strokes, preserving the shared frame, curve topology, arrows and named-state relationships.

Exact central symmetry is an edition-authorized idealization, not a claim that the original scan's pixels or material data were exactly symmetric. Every defining opposite loop vertex is covered by native centralSymmetry; the distinct initial branch is not mirrored.
All seven state coordinates and Bezier control coordinates are internal uncalibrated construction data, not visible measured values.
Labels are moved clear of strokes and use Latin mathematical glyphs with proper primes. No Cyrillic source lettering or aged-paper styling is retained.
The shared upper and lower saturation endpoints are retained without extending beyond the source arms or adding a new curve.

readabilityReview.actualGlyphJudgment: Both screenshots show complete readable I, o, B with a lowered 0, and distinct prime marks. No tofu, missing glyph, raster corruption, ambiguous arrowhead, label collision or clipped arm is visible.
readabilityReview.scrollJudgment: Inline is appropriate: all content fits actual 316px mobile media with >=16px transformed font size and no horizontal overflow. A scroll layout is not required; no untested scroll-end reachability is claimed.
readabilityReview.geometryAndLabelClearance: Labels are separate from curve/axis strokes; all five curve arrowheads have visible direction and the two positive-quadrant branches can be distinguished at mobile width.
readabilityReview.themes: Native SVG exposes semantic ink/paper variables; the inspected neutral appearance is dark ink on white. No separate theme screenshot or full-product theme approval is claimed.
